titleEn: Vancouver Renovation Cost Per Square Foot 2026: Real Numbers From 30 Reno Stars Projects
titleZh: 2026年温哥华装修每平方英尺成本：來自30個聚星装修项目的真实数据
contentEn:
If you are asking how much renovation costs per square foot in Vancouver in 2026, you need real project data—not industry averages that lump a condo kitchen beside a laneway home addition. Reno Stars has tracked actual budgets across 30 completed projects in Metro Vancouver this year. This guide breaks down what those numbers mean for your project.

Across kitchen, bathroom, and whole-house renovations in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Langley, Delta, North Vancouver, and West Vancouver, our 2026 project data shows a cost range of $120–$350 per square foot, depending on scope and finish level. That figure covers labour, materials, and permits—but not major structural work, which can push costs higher.

The only way to know your real cost is to measure the space and multiply by the rate for your project type. The table below shows what our actual 2026 clients paid.

Reno Stars compiled budgets from 30 projects completed or underway in 2026 across Metro Vancouver cities. Square footage is estimated from room size descriptions in project records.

What Drives the Cost Per Square Foot Higher or Lower?

Three factors determine where your project lands within that $120–$350 range:

  • Finish level: A mid-range kitchen renovation in a Richmond townhouse cost $100–$120/sq ft in 2026. The same size luxury kitchen in a West Vancouver house ran $200+/sq ft due to custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and high-end stonework.
  • Scope complexity: Moving plumbing fixtures or rewiring electrical circuits adds $15–$40/sq ft. A tub-to-walk-in-shower conversion in a North Vancouver bathroom cost $250–$270/sq ft because it involved waterproofing, floor slope work, and curbless entry construction.
  • Permit requirements: Bathroom and kitchen renovations in Vancouver requiring a building permit add $2,000–$8,000 to the total budget. Strata approvals for townhouse renovations in Burnaby or Coquitlam add another $500–$2,500 in administrative costs.

Kitchen Renovation Cost Per Square Foot: Vancouver 2026

A kitchen renovation in Vancouver costs $120–$200 per square foot for a mid-range renovation, and $200–$300+ for a luxury kitchen. In 2026, Reno Stars clients paid:

  • Vancouver (House, 400 sq ft): $70,000–$72,000 — custom cabinets, quartz countertops, white shaker style, integrated appliances → $175–$180/sq ft
  • Burnaby (House, 200 sq ft): $35,000–$40,000 — custom cabinets, gold fixtures, wood-vein quartz → $175–$200/sq ft
  • Richmond (Townhouse, 200 sq ft): $20,000–$24,000 — minimalist style, laminate countertop, mid-range fixtures → $100–$120/sq ft
  • Langley (Townhouse, 200 sq ft): $28,000–$30,000 — waterfall island, quartz countertops → $140–$150/sq ft
  • West Vancouver (House, 165 sq ft): $29,000–$33,000 — white cabinets, gold hardware → $175–$200/sq ft

The biggest cost driver in a kitchen is cabinetry, which typically runs $150–$400 per linear foot for custom-built Vancouver-made cabinets. Countertops add another $40–$150 per square foot depending on material. Appliances range from $3,000 (builder-grade) to $20,000+ (professional series).

Bathroom Renovation Cost Per Square Foot: Vancouver 2026

A bathroom renovation in Vancouver costs $130–$270 per square foot. The range is wider than kitchens because bathrooms require more mechanical work (plumbing, waterproofing, ventilation) that does not scale linearly with size. A small luxury bathroom often costs more per square foot than a large basic one.

  • North Vancouver (luxury curbless, 170 sq ft): $42,000–$45,000 → $247–$265/sq ft
  • Burnaby (two-bathroom, 200 sq ft total): $26,000–$30,000 → $130–$150/sq ft
  • Richmond (master bath, 100 sq ft): $15,000–$18,000 → $150–$180/sq ft
  • Richmond (powder room, 20 sq ft): $3,500–$4,000 → $175–$200/sq ft
  • Maple Ridge (custom glass door, 110 sq ft): $18,000–$21,000 → $164–$191/sq ft

Waterproofing alone typically costs $1,500–$4,000 for a Vancouver bathroom. A curbless walk-in shower with linear drain and bench adds $3,000–$8,000 over a standard tub-to-shower conversion.

Whole-House Renovation Cost Per Square Foot: Vancouver 2026

Whole-house renovations in Vancouver in 2026 ranged from $125–$350 per square foot depending on scope. A whole-house renovation that involves structural changes, electrical panel upgrades, and full mechanical replacement costs significantly more per square foot than a cosmetic refresh.

A whole-house renovation in Vancouver for a condo unit ran $25,000–$27,000 for approximately 200 square feet ($125–$135/sq ft). A comparable renovation for a laneway home or larger house with full mechanical replacement and structural work can reach $250–$350/sq ft.

What Does $150 Per Square Foot Actually Get You in Vancouver?

At $150/sq ft (mid-range), your Vancouver renovation budget breaks down roughly as:

  • Labour and trades: $50–$65/sq ft — includes general contractor overhead, electricians, plumbers, tilers, drywall, painters
  • Materials: $60–$75/sq ft — flooring, paint, fixtures, cabinetry (mid-range), countertops (mid-range laminate or quartz)
  • Permits and fees: $10–$25/sq ft — Vancouver building permit, BC Hydro connection if applicable, any strata approvals

At $250/sq ft (upper mid-range), you move into custom cabinetry, natural stone countertops, premium fixtures, and potential structural or mechanical upgrades.

How to Estimate Your Vancouver Renovation Budget in 2026

To estimate your renovation cost, measure your space in square feet and multiply by the rate for your project type:

  • Basic kitchen refresh (cabinet fronts, hardware, paint): $80–$120/sq ft
  • Mid-range kitchen renovation: $120–$200/sq ft
  • Luxury/custom kitchen: $200–$350+/sq ft
  • Basic bathroom refresh: $100–$150/sq ft
  • Mid-to-luxury bathroom: $150–$300/sq ft
  • Whole-house mid-range renovation: $125–$200/sq ft
  • Whole-house luxury or structural: $200–$350+/sq ft

Multiply your square footage by the appropriate rate. A 150-square-foot mid-range kitchen renovation in Burnaby would estimate: 150 × $150 = $22,500. Our 2026 data shows similar Burnaby kitchens at $30,000–$35,000 with custom cabinetry and premium finishes—budget up if you want high-end materials.

Frequently Asked Questions: Vancouver Renovation Cost Per Square Foot 2026

What is the average renovation cost per square foot in Vancouver in 2026?

Based on 30 Reno Stars projects across Metro Vancouver in 2026, the average renovation cost per square foot ranges from $120–$200/sq ft for mid-range kitchen and bathroom work. Luxury projects run $200–$350+/sq ft. These are all-in costs including labour, materials, and permits.

Why do bathroom renovations cost more per square foot than kitchens?

Bathrooms require more mechanical work per square foot than kitchens. Waterproofing, plumbing rough-in, ventilation, and tile work do not scale down proportionally in a small bathroom, which is why a 20-square-foot powder room can cost $3,500–$4,000 ($175–$200/sq ft) while a 150-square-foot kitchen runs $100–$200/sq ft.

Does a whole-house renovation cost less per square foot than a room-by-room renovation?

Yes, typically. A whole-house renovation done as one project benefits from efficiencies: one contractor team, one permit, shared setup costs. Our 2026 data shows whole-house projects at $125–$135/sq ft for mid-range condo work versus $175–$200/sq ft for comparable individual kitchen renovations. However, luxury whole-house renovations with structural work can exceed $350/sq ft.

Do Vancouver renovation costs vary by city?

Yes. West Vancouver and North Vancouver tend toward higher per-square-foot costs due to premium material preferences and larger home sizes. Richmond, Surrey, and Langley show mid-range rates. Burnaby and New Westminster fall in the middle. The biggest factor is still project scope and finish level—not geography.

What permits affect renovation cost per square foot in Vancouver?

In Vancouver proper, a building permit for a kitchen or bathroom renovation typically costs $1,500–$6,000 depending on project value. Electrical upgrades (panel replacement, new circuits) require a BC Hydro permit add another $500–$2,000. In Burnaby and other Metro Vancouver municipalities, strata approval adds $500–$2,500 for townhouse and apartment renovations.

常見問題：2026年溫哥華裝修每平方英尺成本

2026年溫哥華裝修每平方英尺的平均成本是多少？

根據聚星装修2026年在Metro Vancouver的30個項目數據，中檔廚房和浴室裝修的平均成本為每平方英尺120至200加元。豪華項目為每平方英尺200至350加元以上。

為什麼浴室裝修每平方英尺比廚房貴？

浴室需要更多的機電工程。防水、管道粗裝、通風和瓷磚工程在小浴室中不能按比例縮減，這就是為什麼20平方英尺的化妝間造價可達每平方英尺175至200加元。

全屋裝修是否比逐間房間裝修每平方英尺更便宜？

是的，通常如此。一個全屋裝修作為一個項目進行，可享受效率優勢：一個承包商團隊、一個許可證、分攤設置成本。但豪華全屋裝修或結構工程可超過每平方英尺350加元。
